topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I got these flowers today, and they’re beautiful, petals so bright they’re almost blinding, you know? But there’s no card, no note, nothing. I keep staring at them, trying to figure out who might’ve sent them. It’s like a puzzle, and I’m not getting any of the pieces to fit. I even checked the bottom of the vase, the stems, everywhere. Nothing. I don’t know if I should be excited or... well, you know. It’s just weird. What if it’s from someone who’s upset with me, and they’re trying to say something? Or what if it’s just a mix-up, and they were meant for someone else? I don’t know what to think. I just hope it’s not something I need to worry about.
